name: Theme Songs
description: Automatically downloads theme songs for TV series from tvthemes.plexapp.com and saves them as theme.mp3 in each series folder, so Jellyfin's built-in "Play Theme Songs" feature has something to play. Runs nightly as a scheduled task and, optionally, as soon as a new series is added. Never overwrites an existing theme.mp3, and skips series with no TVDB ID.
overview: Downloads TV theme songs and saves them as theme.mp3.
